freeEntry.text: Only the hourly competitions and some weekend events are free; daily entry is $5, weekly $10 and the monthly main event $50. The ledger's 'free to enter' framing only holds for the free tier.
freeEntry.quote: 1 Free Hourly Competitions ... No entry fee, no re-buys ... 2 Daily Competitions - Free or $5 Entry ... 3 Weekly Competitions - Free to Enter or $10 Entry ... 4 Monthly Tournament - Free or $50 Entry

prize.text: Headline prize is a $101,000 pool made up mostly of simulated prop-firm accounts (50K/25K/15K/5K) plus a share of the entry-fee pool; only a minority is described as cash rewards.
prize.quote: $100,000+ Prize Pool. Prizes include BR Prop Accounts and cash rewards ... $50K Prop Account + 50% of Prize Pool

summary: Prop-firm trading contest: free hourly rounds exist, but the $101K monthly event charges $50 to enter and pays mostly in simulated funded accounts, not cash.
flags: Entry fee applies to the daily, weekly and monthly brackets, so it is not a free-to-enter cash competition.
Headline prize is largely prop-account credit tied to a funded-account programme, not withdrawable cash.
Prize pool is partly funded by other entrants' fees (-20% rake on Profit Rush).
